name: Chihiro
source:
Friends with Eri since their elementary days. Gets along well with her. Has no experience with prostitution since she earnestly wishes for a pure love with her boyfriend. Enjoys the company of her boyfriend, but not when it comes to sex. She's never satisfied with his small dick and premature ejaculation.
